diagnosis_text:
Diagnosis 1:
 root_cause: The declared Deployment sets the mem-load container's memory limit to 32Mi while the stress-ng command allocates 50MB per VM worker, so the container exceeds its cgroup memory limit and is OOMKilled on every restart; git must be fixed by raising the limit. root_cause_component: Deployment/vigil-app:mem-load
 recommended_action: git_commit_k8s
